items.title: ACC Cement’s Trust-Based Brand Positioning in Infrastructure - MarkHub24
items.raw_summary: Industry & Competitive ContextWhen Adani Group announced its Holcim deal, Reuters reported that Ambuja and ACC combined could produce at least 70 million tonnes of cement a year, against 120 million tonnes for UltraTech. The two companies owned 31 cement-making facilities and employed over 10,700 people. Adani announced completion of the acquisition on September 16, 2022, valuing the Holcim stake and open-offer consideration at USD 6.50 billion. After the transaction it held 63.15% of Ambuja Cem
